overview_description.description:
Grip is a market engagement platform used by conferences, trade shows, and corporate event organizers to empower professionals to achieve their business goals. 

Used by 13 out of 20 event organizers for both virtual and in-person events, Grip has more than 50 team members spread across Europe and the US.

The company was founded in 2014 by Brent Hoberman and Tim Groot and is based in London.

about_short_description.short_description: Grip is a market engagement platform used by event organizers to create virtual and live event experiences.

product.name: Grip Engage
product.description: An event engagement platform for networking, matchmaking, meeting management, personalized schedules, content access, and participant interaction at in-person, virtual, and hybrid events.

product.name: Grip Event App
product.description: A branded web and mobile event app that provides event schedules, attendee networking, AI recommendations, meeting management, exhibitor directories, lead retrieval, floor plans, notifications, and content access.

product.name: Grip Event Matchmaking
product.description: An AI-powered matchmaking and networking solution that recommends relevant participants, exhibitors, sponsors, sessions, and meeting opportunities based on profiles, preferences, behavior, and event objectives.

product.name: Grip Pre-Scheduled Meetings
product.description: A meeting scheduling solution for arranging curated one-to-one and group meetings between buyers, suppliers, exhibitors, sponsors, investors, and other event participants.

product.name: Grip Manage
product.description: An event management system for registration, sponsor and exhibitor administration, side events, speakers, sessions, and submissions, with integrations for existing event technology stacks.

product.name: Grip Onsite
product.description: A set of onsite event tools for badge printing, entrance scanning, access control, smart exchange of participant information, and location tracking.
